summary: Sanofi filed a Form 6-K reporting routine product approvals and a management appointment: Sarclisa subcutaneous formulation approved in Japan for multiple myeloma, Cenrifki (tolebrutinib) approved in the EU for secondary progressive MS, Wayrilz approved in Japan for immune thrombocytopenia, and the appointment of Paulo Fontoura as Global Head of R&D. These are ordinary business and regulatory updates, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present. The filing is a routine current report of foreign private issuer.
